parameters.query:
-- Upsert extracted products and store the page snapshot in one transaction,
-- so the hash is only saved when the products were.
WITH src AS (
    SELECT source_id, lender, url FROM crawl_sources WHERE source_id = $1
),
incoming AS (
    SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) AS x(
        product_name text, rate_min numeric, rate_max numeric, min_income numeric,
        min_credit_score smallint, min_age smallint, max_age smallint,
        allowed_employment text[], residual_criteria text)
),
upserted AS (
    INSERT INTO loan_products (source_id, lender, product_name, rate_min, rate_max, min_income,
                               min_credit_score, min_age, max_age, allowed_employment,
                               residual_criteria, source_url)
    SELECT s.source_id, s.lender, i.product_name, i.rate_min, i.rate_max, i.min_income,
           i.min_credit_score, i.min_age, i.max_age, i.allowed_employment,
           i.residual_criteria, s.url
    FROM incoming i CROSS JOIN src s
    ON CONFLICT (lender, product_name) DO UPDATE SET
        source_id = EXCLUDED.source_id,
        rate_min = EXCLUDED.rate_min,
        rate_max = EXCLUDED.rate_max,
        min_income = EXCLUDED.min_income,
        min_credit_score = EXCLUDED.min_credit_score,
        min_age = EXCLUDED.min_age,
        max_age = EXCLUDED.max_age,
        allowed_employment = EXCLUDED.allowed_employment,
        residual_criteria = EXCLUDED.residual_criteria,
        source_url = EXCLUDED.source_url,
        active = true,
        last_seen_at = now(),
        needs_rematch = loan_products.needs_rematch OR (
            (loan_products.min_income, loan_products.min_credit_score, loan_products.min_age,
             loan_products.max_age, loan_products.allowed_employment, loan_products.active)
            IS DISTINCT FROM
            (EXCLUDED.min_income, EXCLUDED.min_credit_score, EXCLUDED.min_age,
             EXCLUDED.max_age, EXCLUDED.allowed_employment, true)),
        updated_at = now()
    RETURNING 1
)
UPDATE crawl_sources
SET content_hash = $3, cleaned_text = $4, last_fetched_at = now(), last_changed_at = now(), last_status = 'ok', last_error = NULL
WHERE source_id = $1
RETURNING source_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM upserted) AS products_saved;
UPDATE crawl_sources SET last_fetched_at = now(), last_status = 'ok', last_error = NULL WHERE source_id = $1 RETURNING source_id;
UPDATE crawl_sources SET last_fetched_at = now(), last_status = 'fetch_failed', last_error = $2 WHERE source_id = $1 RETURNING source_id;

parameters.query:
-- Crawled products not seen for 7 days are deactivated, never deleted.
UPDATE loan_products SET active = false, needs_rematch = true, updated_at = now()
WHERE active AND source_id IS NOT NULL AND last_seen_at < now() - interval '7 days'
RETURNING product_id;
